Broj LED-ica na izlazu:: Number of LEDs on the output:
Svaki izlaz kontrolera crta se sa svim s: Each controller output is drawn with all its LEDs, so effects flow smoothly onto fans and LED strips too. Position, shape (strip or ring) and direction are set on the Lighting tab → Device layout. The LED count can only be changed for ARGB outputs: it is written to the controller on the motherboard and also applies to the ASRock software. On exit the motherboard returns to its previous lighting. ASRock Polychrome Sync must be closed.
Upravljaj osvjetljenjem memorije (Kingst: Control the memory lighting (Kingston Fury) – follows the effects
Memorija se ne vidi kao USB uređaj, nego: Memory is not a USB device; it is reached through the SMBus on the motherboard, which needs the PawnIO driver (pawnio.eu). The program carries it inside: when needed it installs it temporarily and removes it on exit (unless you already had it). The program must run as administrator for this. While SVITAC controls the memory, SignalRGB, OpenRGB and similar programs must not run. "Probe RAM" only reads the addresses and writes them to the log.
